avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces griseofulvin plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if fungal treatment ongoing

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 induction may reduce griseofulvin levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid during active antifungal therapy; use alternative immune support

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin A (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Griseofulvin may increase vitamin A absorption; risk of hypervitaminosis A with concurrent high-dose supplementation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of vitamin A toxicity (headache, bone pain, skin changes); consider baseline and periodic vitamin A levels

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical CYP3A4 competition; minimal clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; monitor for reduced griseofulvin efficacy if high doses used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases griseofulvin levels and toxicity risk; may elevate hepatic adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit consumption during treatment; substitute other citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat enhances griseofulvin absorption; variable bioavailability if intake inconsistent
caution_foods.action: Consume with consistent fat content meals (preferably fatty meals) for optimized and predictable absorption

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential additive hepatotoxicity and may cause disulfiram-like reaction; increased GI upset
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol intake; counsel on hepatotoxicity risk, especially with prolonged therapy

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function tests (LFTs) regularly, especially with concurrent alcohol use or pre-existing hepatic impairment. Assess for signs of vitamin A toxicity if patient taking concurrent supplements, and ensure consistent dietary fat intake to maintain stable griseofulvin bioavailability.
